test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In January 2022, which evacuation mission did the government of India launch to evacuate the Indians stranded in Ukraine?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Operation Ganga**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Operation Ganga** was the mission launched by the Government of India in January 2022 to evacuate Indians stranded in Ukraine.
 
• This operation was initiated in response to the escalating conflict between Russia and Ukraine, which posed significant risks to Indian nationals in the region.
 
• The mission involved coordinated efforts by multiple Indian government agencies, including the Ministry of External Affairs, the Indian Air Force, and various airlines, to ensure the safe return of Indian citizens.
 
• Special flights were arranged to facilitate the evacuation, and Indian embassies and consulates in neighboring countries provided necessary assistance to evacuees.
 
• The operation underscored India's commitment to the safety and well-being of its citizens abroad.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Operation Safe Homecoming** was the mission launched in 2011 to evacuate Indians from Libya during the civil war.
 
• **Operation Raahat** was the mission launched in 2015 to evacuate Indians from Yemen during the conflict.
 
• **Operation Vande Bharat** was the mission launched in 2020 to repatriate Indians stranded abroad due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• The Government of India has a history of conducting such evacuation missions to ensure the safety of its citizens during international crises.
